text:
anya: Quick flag — bringing up hf/vela-12b (int4) and seeing weird trimming of punctuation and collapsed blank lines on multilingual summaries (es/fr). Baseline int8 OK. filing notes here.

matt: short repro?

anya: small eval script: run our multilingual-smoke on ~200 examples. int4 outputs drop trailing punctuation (e.g. 'Hola.' -> 'Hola') and runs of 2+ newlines become 1. BLEU/ROUGE drop ~3 points on the small set.

liam: could be tokenizer detokenize or token id mapping after conversion. Did the conversion script change recently?

anya: converter unchanged last week. I diffed merges; BPE merges identical. But I did see some tokens that previously were separate (word + punctuation) are now a single merged token id after conversion.

zoe: that smells like a packing/byteorder issue in the weight conversion where token ids shift by an offset for a subset. Any headwise attention signal changes?

anya: dug into kvcache phase stats. Heads 5-6 roughly match baseline. Heads 10-13 have phase_mean offsets ~0.17-0.2 — big compared to baseline ~0.0.

frank: share the snippet.

anya: ```
rotary_phase_summary: head05 baseline=0.004 vela_int4=0.006
rotary_phase_summary: head10 baseline=-0.002 vela_int4=0.178  <-- suspect
rotary_phase_summary: head11 baseline=0.001 vela_int4=0.190
```

liam: Those heads being clustered suggests a per-head scaling factor got misapplied during convert_weights. We had a branch that multiplies rotary_scale by `head_group_factor` when headdim is divisible by 2 to handle legacy concat layouts.

matt: that conditional was risky. Which models require it?

anya: older 'graft' models. But vela has metadata key `rotary_policy: per_head_uniform`. I traced convert_weights: it applies the factor unconditionally unless `--legacy-headconcat` flag is provided. our pipeline didn't set that flag.

frank: easy fix: guard the scaling with a metadata check (skip for per_head_uniform). Can you try a local convert + quant and re-eval?

anya: patched locally to: if model_meta.get('rotary_policy') == 'per_head_uniform': skip head_group scaling. Re-ran int4 pack -> phases back in line (<0.01 diff). punctuation + blankline issues gone in sample outputs.

zoe: any change to model size or perf?

anya: none. int4 blob identical size; perf same.

matt: open PR with patch + test. Add a tiny unit that constructs toy weights with 4 heads, runs conversion both ways and asserts phase parity vs baseline. Also add the Spanish punctuation mini-dataset to repro-data.

liam: also add a tokenizer regression check: run tokenizer on samples with punctuation and assert tokenization boundaries equal baseline tokenizer (sanity diff).

frank: +1 on tests. Add a short doc note under onboarding: checklist item to compare per-head rotary phase means between original and converted weights.

anya: will add all that. PR will include: 
- converter guard for per_head_uniform
- unit test for rotary parity (toy model)
- tokenizer boundary sanity test
- repro pack (es/fr small set)

ci-bot: ci/onboard-vela-int4 queued.

ci-bot: ci/onboard-vela-int4 FAILED 1:03 12m timeout while running multilingual-smoke. Rerun queued.

matt: looks flaky. rerun. good to have tests though.

ci-bot: ci/onboard-vela-int4 PASSED 1:34 multilingual-smoke OK.

anya: merging PR. Post-merge: I ran `git grep "per_head_uniform"` across model manifests and found 6 other models that might hit the same branch. I'll kick batch reconvert jobs for those.

liam: ping infra and schedule low-priority batch to reconvert and re-run onboarding smoke. prioritize ones with int4 active.

frank: I'll add a lint rule in the converter to warn when `--legacy-headconcat` is used but metadata says per_head_uniform. That should prevent similar mistakes.

anya: love that. Closing thread after batch jobs scheduled. Thanks all. :party_popper:
